item.title: William Blake, Remote by the Sea
Recover Apple Keychain
item.description:
📝 After some digging, I found that keychain data is stored at: ~/Library/Keychains The main file is: login. keychain-db During the password reset, macOS had moved the original keychain to: login_renamed_1. Steps to restore keychain data Navigate to: ~/Library/Keychains Remove the newly created keychain (make sure it doesn’t contain anything important): rm login.
🔗 Read more: https://arkoinad.com/posts/apple_keychain_recovery.html
